title: Success count as a Boolean list count
statement: For every natural number $k$ and every function $\omega:\{0,\ldots,k-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, the sum of the indicators of the indices where $\omega$ is true equals the number of occurrences of true in the list of its values.
